data.name: Temple of Sandur
data.detailed_description:
Temple of Sandur is a co-op puzzle adventure set in a lost desert temple where sand itself bends time. Use a mystical hourglass to reshape the world, solve ancient puzzles, and escape the creatures that awaken beneath the dunes.

Play solo or with friends—the temple adapts to both. While every puzzle is built for teamwork, brave explorers can still take on the challenge alone.

Use the power of sand to turn back time, rebuild what’s been lost, and uncover paths that were once buried. Collapsed bridges rise again, walls crumble in reverse, and the temple’s structure shifts in your favor if you know how to control it.

Every puzzle can be solved on your own, but playing together adds new dynamics and unexpected moments of teamwork. Share discoveries, coordinate your actions, or simply experience the temple side by side. Whether solo or co-op, every run through the temple feels different.

The deeper you go, the more it reacts. Footsteps echo, sand stirs, and something starts to move in the dark. Stay quiet, keep your light low, and remember that the temple never forgets those who disturb its peace.

  • Co-op puzzle adventure for up to 4 players

  • Hourglass mechanics that bend time and environment

  • Team-based challenges requiring precision and timing

  • Atmospheric exploration through ancient ruins

  • Now in Alpha — core puzzles and sand mechanics ready to explore. New areas, creatures, and story elements are being shaped over time, so players can experience the temple’s evolution from the very beginning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: MVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
